content: {"like":["Captivating documentary about a great director rarely recognised outside of Hollywood","Very interesting documentary on the films of John G Avildsen, especially his biggest ROCKY and The Karate Kid movies","Honest and open interviews with actors and people he worked with","Fascinating interviews from actors","Interesting insights into movies John passed on or was fired from","Raw footage of John Travolta in Saturday Night Fever","Early casting calls with Sigourney Weaver, Matthew McConaughey, Daniel Craig","Scene where John meets Frank Capra and learns about studio politics","Focus on underdog characters in ROCKY and The Karate Kid","John’s Oscar acceptance speech (though only a snippet)","Bill Conti’s powerful musical score for both movies","Overall 5-star rating and willingness to watch more about John’s other films"],"dislike":["Some parts of the film seemed rushed","Lack of full Oscar acceptance speech (only a snippet)","Film could have focused more on the impact of ROCKY and The Karate Kid on Hollywood","Duplication and clone films mentioned but not explored in depth"]}
